cut.fz_basis: Base chip load (IPT) per tooth before the Table 1 neck-length adjustment; Deburring = engagement around the ball of 20 deg or less, Profiling = 90 deg engagement, Slotting = full engagement along 180 deg of the ball

adjustments.published: Table 1 (Neck Length Multiple / Chip Load): 3x 120%, 5x 100%, 8x 80%, 12x 65%, 15x 55% (vendor gives no interpolation)

published.ae_radial: Depth of Cut given only as number of passes

vendor_notes: Posted values are Base Chip Loads and do not account for varying neck lengths; use Table 1 to calculate the final adjusted chip load
Suggested starting values; chip loads reflect uncoated cutters and may be increased 10%-20% if coated; ferrous <= 28 Rc +10%-20%
rows.notes: Neck length 1.0000" (1) / neck diameter 0.3230" = 3.10. cutter_thickness is the catalog Length of Cut of the spherical head; corner_radius is half the cutter diameter (ball), not a catalog field.

source.cells: SFM 150; Profiling base chip load (IPT) .00080; Depth of Cut passes 3
